defs.def: a building, column, statue, etc. built to remind people of a famous person or event 纪念碑（或馆、堂、像等）

ex.s: Yellowstone was the ____49____ (large) United States national park — 2.2 million acres — until Wrangell-Saint Elias in southern Alaska, _____50_____ became a national monument in 1978, took the honors as a national park in 1980 with 12.3 million acres.
ex.t: 黄石是美国____最大的国家公园——220万英亩——直到阿拉斯加南部的兰格尔-圣埃利亚斯于1978年成为国家纪念地，并于1980年以1230万英亩的面积成为国家公园。____

ex.s: We will visit some of the best-preserved Roman monuments in the world.
ex.t: 我们将参观世界上保存最完好的罗马古迹之一。

ex.s: Your guide will provide a history lesson about the trees and the famous monuments where they blossom.

ex.t: 这个小型团体自行车之旅是欣赏华盛顿特区著名樱花盛开的绝佳方式。

ex.s: Join a guided bike tour and view some of the most popular monuments in Washington, D.C.
ex.t: 在还有空位之前尽快预订——樱花可是会凋谢的！

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 华盛顿首都纪念碑自行车之旅

ex.s: Get up close to the monuments and memorials as your bike the sites of Capitol Hill and the National Mall.
ex.t: 当你骑行经过国会山和国家广场的景点时，可以近距离观赏那些纪念碑和纪念建筑。
华盛顿首都纪念碑自行车之旅

defs.def: a building that has special historical importance 历史遗迹；有历史价值的建筑

ex.s: As we travel south from Madrid with Prof Ronald Messier to historic Toledo，Roman Merida and into Andalucia, we explore historical monuments and architecture.
ex.t: 当我们从马德里向南旅行，由Ronald Messier教授带领前往历史名城托莱多、罗马城市梅里达并进入安达卢西亚地区时，我们将探索历史古迹和建筑。

defs.def: a thing that remains as a good example of sb's qualities or of what they did 典范；典型

ex.s: If the Taj Mahal is a celebration of the heart, then the Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties are a monument to the mind and spirit.
ex.t: 如果说泰姬陵是心灵的礼赞，那么明清皇家陵寝则是思想与精神的丰碑。

ex.s: The Eiffel Tower is the most famous landmark in France, and one of the most visiting monuments in the world.
ex.t: 埃菲尔铁塔是法国最著名的地标，也是世界上参观人数最多的纪念碑之一。

ex.s: The chief engineer, Gustave Eiffel, replied say that such a large monument was necessary to symbolise the great efforts of the French people as well as the great advancements in modern engineering, industry, and science.
ex.t: 总工程师古斯塔夫\u00b7埃菲尔回答说，建这样一个大型纪念碑是必要的，它象征着法国人民的巨大努力以及现代工程、工业和科学的巨大进步。
